name: Intraday time-series momentum: first half-hour return predicts last half-hour return (non-US indices)
author_year: Li, Sakkas and Urquhart (2022, Journal of Financial Markets 57, 100619), extending Gao, Han, Li and Zhou (2018, Journal of Financial Economics 129(2):394-414)
instrument: 16 developed-market equity indices in Li et al. (2022); DAX, FTSE 100, Nikkei 225, Hang Seng and Euro Stoxx 50 are the target set. Per-market results for these five NOT verified [uncertain]. Maven MT5 symbol mapping [uncertain]: not checked in terminal.
timeframe: Intraday 30-minute windows (first and last half-hour of session); underlying high-frequency bars, bar size [uncertain]
entry_rule: At start of last half-hour, enter in the direction of the first half-hour return. Exact implementation from the paper not read [uncertain].
exit_rule: Exit at the close of the last half-hour window (session close).
stop_rule: No stop in the Gao et al. design; no stop distance reported in sources [uncertain].
trades_per_year: About 250 per market per year if traded every session [uncertain]; actual count depends on filter.
overnight_weekend: No overnight position for the trade leg. The signal leg (prior close to first half-hour) includes the overnight gap, which is known before entry.
signal_window_definition: First half-hour: prior session close to end of first 30 minutes (includes overnight return per Gao et al. convention). Last half-hour: final 30 minutes before close. A pure intraday variant (excluding overnight) was NOT tested in any source found [uncertain]. DST handling not stated in sources [uncertain].
sample_period: Gao et al. (2018): SPY, 1993-2013. Li et al. (2022): exact period [uncertain], not accessible (access blocked).
out_of_sample: Secondary summary of Li et al. (2022) says significant in-sample and out-of-sample predictability in most countries. Numeric out-of-sample results NOT verified [uncertain].
cost_assumption: [uncertain] Not stated in any source read in this run. Gao et al. cost treatment not verified.
reported_metrics: Gao et al.: predictive R-squared about 1.6% (secondary summary of working paper). Li et al.: significant in 12 of 16 markets; pooled relationship positive and significant (secondary summary). Coefficients and Sharpe not retrieved [uncertain].
third_party_replication: Partial. Li et al. (2022) is an independent multi-country extension by different authors. Informal US-ETF replications (deadsignalslab, temperancecapital blogs) find no net edge after 2 bp round-trip cost over 2014-2026 (not peer-reviewed).
evidence_grade: peer-reviewed (Li et al. 2022 JFM; Gao et al. 2018 JFE); claim verified only through secondary summaries [uncertain]
decay_status: Mixed. SPY-family replication: strong 2000-2012, flat 2013-2019 (temperancecapital); net negative 2014-2026 with 2 bp cost (deadsignalslab). Non-US decay not assessed [uncertain].
regime_split: Gao et al.: effect stronger on high-volume, high-volatility, recession and macro-news days. Replication: IWM gross +1.40 bp/day pre-2018, +0.08 bp after 2018; net negative after 2 bp cost. Pre/post-2022 split for non-US indices NOT found [uncertain].
data_source_requirement: Index/CFD minute bars sufficient (no options, VIX, TICK or funding). Availability of 30-min bars for these five indices on Maven MT5 or Dukascopy [uncertain].
min_lot_fit_5k10k: [uncertain] Not computable from sources: contract multiplier and index point value per instrument not verified. The strategy has no defined stop, so per-trade risk % must be set by lot size directly; compute with Maven contract spec before use.
fn_rule_fit: [uncertain] Not checked against FN rules. DAX last half-hour is 17:00-17:30 CET (11:00-11:30 ET); FTSE last half-hour is 17:00-17:30 CET as well (16:00-16:30 London). The US 10:00 ET release (16:00 CET) falls before these windows, so the FN +-5 min news rule should rarely apply; not verified [uncertain]. No HFT/grid pattern.
bot_policy_compliance: Rule-based and bot-compatible in principle; no messaging link needed. FN policy text not verified [uncertain].
event_overlap: Last half-hour of DAX/FTSE (17:00-17:30 CET) overlaps the closing auction; the US 10:00 ET release (16:00 CET) comes before it. Nikkei and Hang Seng close at different local times and were not checked. Not quantified [uncertain].
overlap_with_existing: Not measured [uncertain]. Conceptually related to existing intraday direction logic (Sweep, NB), but no correlation computed in this run.
rejected_catalog_hit: YES: gao_itsm_first30_last30 is already in the rejected catalog (scope: first-30 sign to last-30 sign; catalog says 8 markets, while Li et al. cover 16). Rejection reason not read. Confirm with: python -m intraday.elenenler --kontrol itsm
base_rate_check: Predictive R-squared about 1.6% indicates a small conditional effect over a roughly 50% base rate of direction. Win rate versus base rate not reported in sources [uncertain].
pitfall_risk: Post-hoc market selection (12 of 16 significant; the list of the 4 failing markets not verified); cost fragility (replication shows net-negative at 2 bp round trip); overlapping-leg risk low (one trade per session); small-sample subgroup risk if filtered by volume or volatility.
